summary: Duplex with surety bond: allowed plumbing shift, punitive-damages fee carve-out, ban on all national flags.

findings.quote: No flags of any nation, including the United States flag, may be displayed from the premises.
except that no attorney fees shall be awarded in any action in which punitive or exemplary damages are sought.

nearMisses.quote: Tenants will repair and maintain the plumbing fixtures and drains in the upstairs unit.
Landlord has posted a surety bond with the Marion County clerk of court as provided by law
nearMisses.note: surety bond is an allowed holding method
